builders.title: Builders
builders.noSetups: This setup has no validator client that can use builders
builders.intro: From Glamsterdam on, the validator clients ask the relays for blocks themselves instead of going through MEV-Boost. Each validator client has its own settings.
builders.migrationMissing: No builder address on {network} yet: {relays}. They can be added once they serve one.

title.ready: Answers the ePBS builder API (HTTP {status}), checked from the server

title.unreachable: No answer from the server's side (HTTP {status})

boostHint.default: Each client's own choice: Lodestar and Teku take a bid only when it pays about 11% more than the local block, the others whenever it pays more.
boostHint.local: Always build the block locally, never take a bid.
boostHint.profit: Take the bid whenever it pays more than the local block.
boostHint.custom: A bid counts at this percent of its value against the local block: 100 = equal, 90 = the bid needs about 11% more, 0 = always local.

builders.maxPaymentHint: A builder pays through the protocol, which is enforced, and can promise more inside its block, which is not. 0: only the enforced payment counts. Above 0: promised payments count too, up to this amount.
builders.trustedWarning: If the builder does not publish its block, the promised payment and the block's reward are lost, and the builder cannot be penalized for it. Lodestar needs --allowDangerousTrustedPayments for this, Stereum adds it.
builders.authHint: Hex agreed with the relay. Empty: the relay's host name, which all relays accept.

status.update: Needs {client} {minimum} or newer for the fork
status.noRelease: No release for this fork yet
status.dvtNoRelease: Its cluster's {client} has no release for this fork yet
status.dvtPending: Waiting for Charon's proposer config: start Charon 2.0 once, then save
status.dvtRestart: Restart to load Charon's current proposer config
status.charonFlags: {middleware}'s builder flags differ from its proposer config: save to match them
status.outOfSync: Saved settings not on it yet: save again

note.auth-ignored: This client ignores auth data and always uses the host name
note.no-limits: Nimbus before 26.10.1 has no minimum bid and counts every promised payment

source.mevBoost: Not saved yet. Taken over from this setup's MEV-Boost: its relays that already serve Glamsterdam, its minimum bid and the block choice the validator clients use now.
source.local: Not saved yet. This setup has no MEV-Boost, so its validator clients build their blocks themselves. Choose relays to take blocks from builders after the fork, or keep none.
source.cluster: Not saved yet. Taken over from {middleware}'s proposer config, which every operator of the cluster shares.

builders.cluster: Obol cluster: these builders go to {middleware}, and every operator sets the same ones.
builders.clusterNoAuth: {middleware} takes builder URLs only: each builder is authenticated with its host name.
builders.noRelaysHint: Without relays the validator clients still get bids that builders send over the network, and build the block themselves when those pay less.
builders.minBidHint: Bids that pay less are ignored and the block is built locally. 0 = no minimum.

calc.title: Try it out: one bid against the local block
calc.uses: With this client's Bids settings: block choice {boost}%, minimum bid {minBid} ETH, max trusted payment {max} ETH.
calc.promisedHint: Only relays' bids can carry promised payments, and they count up to the max trusted payment (Bids).
calc.noClients: No validator client uses these settings.
calc.footnote: The same goes for bids builders send over the network. If the local block is not ready in time, most clients take the bid anyway.

why.below-min: The bid counts {counted} ETH, less than the minimum bid of {minBid} ETH.
why.boost-zero: Prefer local: the bid is never taken.
why.higher: {boost}% of {counted} = {boosted} ETH beats the local block's {local} ETH.
why.lower: {boost}% of {counted} = {boosted} ETH does not beat the local block's {local} ETH. A bid needs more than about {needed} ETH.

apply.text: The builder settings of this setup are not applied yet. After the Glamsterdam fork MEV-Boost is no longer used, so the validator clients only get builder blocks with these settings.

reminder.taken: Taken over from MEV-Boost: {relays}. Check them and save.
